notes: Collision library objects are asset-local export hulls; pair by UCX names. They are hidden in render.
Individual placement objects carry Prop=true and tags=Prop. No ISM grouping or representative-only eligibility.
Asset meshes contain canonical material slots; placements have no instance-level material overrides.
Authored collision does not verify Character capsule fitting, selection traces or network behavior.
All physical floor, ceiling, wall and console context has canonical static-asset collision; nonblocking visual elements have explicit categories and reasons.
UCX local transforms are baked into mesh-space; all hull object transforms are identity. Structural context pivots deliberately use geometric centres.
The shopping basket is an eligible collision-stress sample near the aisle edge; dynamic navigation and disguised-character movement remain untested.
